tests.label: general_semantics/integral_data_grouping

assertions.expected: IntegralProperty groups AO and MO one-/two-body tensors under the correct keys.

tests.rationale: The assertion inspects an internal dictionary layout, an ordinary grouping behavior.

tests.label: interface/missing_key_lookup

assertions.expected: get_electronic_integral returns the stored AO one-body tensor or None for missing rank/basis.

tests.rationale: The test directly exercises the public lookup return contract.

tests.label: quantum_semantics/fermionic_basis_rotation

assertions.expected: AO-to-MO transform with 2I scales one-body integrals by 4 and two-body by 16.

tests.rationale: The coefficient powers arise from orbital-basis transformation of electronic integrals.

tests.label: quantum_semantics/fermionic_tensor_mapping

assertions.expected: Stored integrals generate the expected fermionic ladder terms and coefficients.

tests.rationale: The result is compared against a full second-quantized operator list.

tests.label: interface/input_validation

assertions.expected: OneBodyElectronicIntegrals rejects incompatible tensor types with TypeError.

tests.rationale: The selected constructor case checks public argument validation.

tests.label: quantum_semantics/spin_orbital_integral_mapping

assertions.expected: One-body spatial orbital integrals expand to expected spin-orbital matrices.

tests.rationale: The to_spin test checks alpha/beta block placement.

tests.label: quantum_semantics/fermionic_tensor_mapping

assertions.expected: One-body integrals yield expected fermionic terms and coefficients.

tests.rationale: The selected one-body operator conversion checks ladder labels.

tests.label: interface/input_validation

assertions.expected: TwoBodyElectronicIntegrals rejects incompatible tensor types with TypeError.

tests.rationale: This separate two-body constructor case checks public validation.

tests.label: quantum_semantics/spin_orbital_integral_mapping

assertions.expected: Two-body spatial tensors expand to expected spin-orbital tensor blocks.

tests.rationale: The selected to_spin test checks spin index placement.

tests.label: quantum_semantics/fermionic_tensor_mapping

assertions.expected: Two-body integrals yield expected four-ladder terms and coefficients.

tests.rationale: The selected conversion compares each expected fermionic term.

rationale: Reviewed all four IntegralProperty tests and six one-/two-body integral regression tests; internal grouping, public missing-key behavior and physical basis/operator transforms are separated.
